Fig. 13. Open in a new tab An 11-year-old boy with flexor tendon injury of 3 month duration in the left middle finger. The proximal end (dotted circle) is seen at the MCP joint, and tendons are normal proximal to it. This helps in deciding the tendon reconstruction with a tendon graft. The location of tendons and defect length can be measured using ultrasound

Fig. 14. Open in a new tab a Sixty-five-year-old woman with a non-traumatic flexor pollicis longus (FPL) tendon injury of thumb of 5 years. The gap was 12 cm. These images helped the surgeon plan the FDS ring finger tendon transfer to the FPL distal end
